why: Count the zig-zag teeth on each wing. Each step both wings get one more tooth, and the right wing always has one more than the left. So the next insect needs more teeth than figure 3 on both wings: option 3. Options 1, 2 and 4 have fewer teeth, so they go backwards.
trick: When figures look the same, count small parts (teeth, lines, dots) and see how the count grows.
note: Exact tooth counts are hard to read on the scan; the drawing keeps the +1 per step idea.
